podcast.title: Breakup During Second Album Production
podcast.body: The band embarked on tours but faced difficulties staying cohesive on the road, leading to their breakup while in the process of working on a follow-up album, from which only one song was completed. "They embarked on some tours, but couldn't hold it together while they were on the road. They broke up while they were working on another album, and only one song from that record was ever really finished."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Charles Boname's Beatles Tribute Role
podcast.body: Guitarist Charles Boname joined a Beatles tribute act called Fab Forever, where he performs as George Harrison. "Guitarist Charles Bono-Me ended up in a Beatles tribute act called Fab Forever. He plays George Harrison."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Christopher Paulin's Journalism Career
podcast.body: Bass player Christopher Paulin pursued a career as a journalist, specializing in natural resources, and his work has been extensively published across various platforms. "The bass player Christopher Paulin is a journalist who is especially natural resources. His work has been published many, many times in many, many different places."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Cliff Boyd's Career in Web Design
podcast.body: Following the band's dissolution, singer Cliff Boyd transitioned into a career as a web designer and holds a Master of Science in Information Systems. "Singer Cliff Boyd now works as a web designer. He has a Master of Science in Information Systems."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: No Second Record
podcast.body: Despite achieving a big radio hit with "Whatever," Slow Burn never released a second full-length album. "Unfortunately there was never a second record from Slow Burn."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Vancouver Origins
podcast.body: The band hailed from Vancouver. "They were from Vancouver."
